utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for any carpool updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. If you hear anything, just let me know and we’ll keep the plan simple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything. Hope it stays nice and simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Around 7:30 works for me. I’ll text you if that changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, 7:30 it is. Text me if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and pickup spot first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the time and pickup spot for me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m still a little fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me the plan again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’ve got a quick plan: we’re picking up Maya first, then Sam, and I’ll handle the timing list. If you can take Wednesday morning, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wednesday morning works for me — just send me Maya and Sam’s pickup order again and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I have the details right—what time are we leaving, and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—just tell me the departure time and the riders, and I’ll make sure it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can work around the school pickup time—what evening is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s Thursday evening at 7 at my place—if that still works, I can save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thursday at 7 works for me—thanks, Jules. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus—happy to help with the carpool. What time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam—let’s leave at 7:30 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t logged the carpool spot yet—where should I note the pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Please note it by the front office pickup list, and I’ll confirm the time after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note it by the front office pickup list. I’ll wait for your time confirmation after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, I heard the carpool might need one more driver this week—want me to check with everyone?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, please do—I’d be happy to help if there’s still a spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and see if there’s still a spot for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow, or should I make other plans?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, we’re still on for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll let others know the carpool plan and keep it consistent.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update and go with whatever the plan is.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with everyone and share the carpool plan soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the carpool together now. What days and times work best for you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa — weekday mornings are best for me, usually around 8:00. If anything changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Uli — I’ll pencil you in for weekday mornings around 8:00. I’ll reach out if the route shifts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Eli — I haven’t heard any carpool updates yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please do ask around and let me know the plan when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — are we still good for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still good — I’m planning to head out in about 10 minutes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’m grabbing my stuff now and I’ll be ready in a few.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hi Uli — I’m still checking my schedule for the carpool. I’ll let you know as soon as I’m sure.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Just let me know when you’ve figured it out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’m looking at it tonight, and I’ll tell you tomorrow if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time are we doing carpool?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s do 8:15 at my driveway.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll be there at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can help coordinate the carpool—what time should I plan for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you plan for 7:30 AM, and please double-check with me if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll plan for 7:30 AM and check in with you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—carpool, right. What time are we doing it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think we said 7:30 tomorrow morning—does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 7:30 should work for me. Thanks for checking—I almost missed that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Gus, any update on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira, not yet — I’m still waiting to hear back, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — appreciate it. Just give me a shout when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Mornings on weekdays would help most — around 8:00 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, 8:00 on weekdays works for me. Tell me which mornings you need, and I’ll plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and parking, honestly. Can we check the pickup route and make sure everyone has a clear spot?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll check the pickup route and line up a clear spot for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina. If you can confirm the route and parking spot ahead of time, I’ll feel a lot better about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together the carpool list—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, save me a spot. I can bring some snacks if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, snacks would be great—thanks! I’ve got you on the list, and I’ll send the pickup details soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren — are we still on for the school carpool this week?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — yes, I think so! Just remind me of the days again, and I’ll make sure I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I need help on Monday and Wednesday, and maybe Friday if your schedule works. Thanks, I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m getting the carpool list organized now. Want me to add your family’s preferred days and pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — I’m still getting the hang of everything, so a second-hand update would be great. We’d prefer weekday mornings if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — weekday mornings it is. If you have a preferred pickup time, send it over and I’ll add it to the list.
